name: default_3d_stardist
description: Restored fine-tuned StarDist 3D model with voxel-spacing correction.

settings.label: Object diameter (px)
settings.tooltip: Estimated average nucleus diameter in pixels. This controls overall object-size scaling; image metadata automatically corrects relative Z, Y, and X voxel geometry when available.

settings.label: Prob threshold
settings.tooltip: Minimum object probability required to keep a predicted nucleus candidate.

settings.label: NMS threshold
settings.tooltip: Overlap threshold for non-maximum suppression when removing duplicate detections.
